name: Popover
description: An anchored, non-modal panel with interactive content, for a short task tied to one control. A role=dialog panel: focus moves in when it opens and returns to the trigger when it closes; Escape and an outside click close it. The panel flips to the other side when there's no room, and start and end follow the reading direction.

livewire.name: popover
capabilities: wire:model binds open both ways through $wire.entangle()

props.name: open
props.description: Whether it's open. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model:open. Emitted as data-state on the trigger and the panel.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The initial state of an uncontrolled popover.

props.name: placement
props.description: The trigger's side the panel sits on, lined up with the trigger's start edge. start and end follow the reading direction. Emitted as data-placement; the side the machine settled on, after flipping, is data-side.

props.name: arrow
props.description: Draws the arrow that points at the trigger.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, linked to the panel with aria-labelledby.
props.a11y: The panel's accessible name. Without a title, give the popover an aria-label.

props.name: actions
props.description: A row of actions at the end of the panel.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The control that opens it. Text renders an outline Button; an element (a Button, an icon button) becomes the trigger itself.

props.name: portal
props.description: Renders the panel at the end of the body, above everything (x-teleport, a React portal, Vue Teleport). Off renders it in place. Tab past the last control returns after the trigger either way.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { title: '…', body: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The panel, carrying the root class. It is Zag's content part, so it also carries data-part="content" (D-019).

parts.name: content
parts.description: The panel: the same element as root.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: The control that opens the panel.

parts.name: positioner
parts.description: Places the panel against the trigger.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: The trigger: text for a Button, or the element to use as the trigger.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Rich title content, rendered inside the heading.

events.name: open-change
events.description: The popover opened or closed itself: the trigger, Escape or an outside click. Setting open doesn't fire it.

keyboard.action: On the trigger, opens or closes the popover; focus moves to its first control.
Move between the controls inside; past the last one, focus moves on after the trigger and the popover closes.
Closes the popover and returns focus to the trigger.

requirements: The panel is role=dialog, labelled by its title (or an aria-label), and isn't modal: the page stays usable.
The trigger has aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Focus moves into the panel when it opens and returns to the trigger on Escape.
start and end follow the reading direction, and the panel flips to stay in the viewport.
Text keeps 4.5:1 and the panel's edge 3:1 on the overlay surface in every theme.
Every part keeps a stable, server-rendered id in Livewire, so morphs never replace the panel (D-015).
Keep it to a short task: don't put a long form in a popover.

fixture.content: Anyone on the marketing team can view it.
